pull.title: KAFKA-21360: Revoke topics no member subscribes to in the heterogeneous share assignor
pull.body:
SimpleHeterogeneousAssignmentBuilder computes per-topic assignments only
for topics in the union of the members' subscriptions. As a result,
partitions of topics that no member subscribes to anymore were carried
over from the existing assignment into the new target assignment.

Revoke these topics before computing the per-topic assignments, matching
the homogeneous builder's behavior, and remove the unreachable branch in
revokeUnassignablePartitions that attempted to handle them.

Reviewers: Sean Quah <squah@confluent.io>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

@@ -760,6 +760,57 @@ public void testAssignWithUnsubscribedTopicHeterogeneous() {
         assertEveryPartitionGetsAssignment(6, computedAssignment);
     }
 
+    @Test
+    public void testAssignWithTopicUnsubscribedByAllMembersHeterogeneous() {
+        CoordinatorMetadataImage metadataImage = new MetadataImageBuilder()
+            .addTopic(TOPIC_1_UUID, TOPIC_1_NAME, 4)
+            .addTopic(TOPIC_2_UUID, TOPIC_2_NAME, 2)
+            .addTopic(TOPIC_3_UUID, TOPIC_3_NAME, 2)
+            .buildCoordinatorMetadataImage();
+        SubscribedTopicDescriberImpl subscribedTopicMetadata = new SubscribedTopicDescriberImpl(
+            metadataImage
+        );
+
+        // No member subscribes to topic 2 anymore, but both members still have a partition of it
+        Map<String, MemberSubscriptionAndAssignmentImpl> members = new HashMap<>();
+        members.put(MEMBER_A, new MemberSubscriptionAndAssignmentImpl(
+            Optional.empty(),
+            Optional.empty(),
+            Set.of(TOPIC_1_UUID),
+            new Assignment(mkAssignment(
+                mkTopicAssignment(TOPIC_1_UUID, 0),
+                mkTopicAssignment(TOPIC_2_UUID, 0)))
+        ));
+        members.put(MEMBER_B, new MemberSubscriptionAndAssignmentImpl(
+            Optional.empty(),
+            Optional.empty(),
+            Set.of(TOPIC_1_UUID, TOPIC_3_UUID),
+            new Assignment(mkAssignment(
+                mkTopicAssignment(TOPIC_1_UUID, 1),
+                mkTopicAssignment(TOPIC_2_UUID, 1)))
+        ));
+
+        GroupSpec groupSpec = new GroupSpecImpl(metadataImage, members, HETEROGENEOUS);
review_comments.body: Thanks for fixing this bug. Just fyi, I'm doing some refactoring of the `GroupSpec`s and if #23896 merges first, we should be using the `ShareGroupSpecImpl` class here

issue_comments.body:
@AndrewJSchofield Following up on your offer in #23874, this is the fix for the heterogeneous builder keeping partitions of topics that no member subscribes to (KAFKA-21360). Could you take a look when you have time? It also needs `ci-approved` to run the full CI.

Testing:
- New test `testAssignWithTopicUnsubscribedByAllMembersHeterogeneous` fails without the fix (the unsubscribed topic stays in the member's assignment) and passes with it.
- `SimpleAssignorTest` passes, along with `checkstyleTest` and `spotlessCheck`.
